test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion loss and gradient computation using gtn forward_score and backward
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion loss and gradient computation with transition graphs and emissions
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi decoding path using gtn viterbi_path on composed graphs

create_ctc_graph: create a CTC lattice graph from a target sequence and blank label index
